    // The point on a single cubic Hermite segment at t.
    Eval(self: HermiteCurve3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Start.PositionVector
               .Hermite(self.End.PositionVector, self.StartTangent, self.EndTangent, t)
               .ToPoint;

    // The point on a piecewise cubic Hermite spline at t: the Hermite segment
    // spanning the two knots that bracket t, with their explicit tangents.
    Eval(self: HermiteSpline2D, t: Number): Point2D
    {
        var n = self.Points.Count;
        var i = n.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t);
        var u = n.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t);
        return self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed).PositionVector
            .Hermite(self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                     self.Tangents.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                     self.Tangents.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed),
                     u)
            .ToPoint;
    }

    // The point on a piecewise cubic Hermite spline at t.
    Eval(self: HermiteSpline3D, t: Number): Point3D
    {
        var n = self.Points.Count;
        var i = n.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t);
        var u = n.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t);
        return self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed).PositionVector
            .Hermite(self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                     self.Tangents.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                     self.Tangents.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed),
                     u)
            .ToPoint;
    }

    //==
    // # Evaluating the interpolating splines
    //
    // Evaluation of the curves declared in `splines.types.plato`:
    // Catmull-Rom, Kochanek-Bartels (TCB), piecewise-linear, and the accessors of
    // the natural cubic spline. The cubic bases themselves live in
    // `library Polynomials` (`polynomials.types.plato`), generic over `INumerical`, and the
    // piecewise indexing helpers (SpanCount / SpanIndex / SpanFraction / AtWrapped)
    // in the sections above; nothing is reimplemented here.
    //
    // Conventions:
    //   * A chain of n points has n - 1 spans when open and n when Closed (the
    //     last point joins back to the first).
    //   * Control points are converted to displacements with PositionVector before
    //     entering a `INumerical`-generic basis function and back with ToPoint, the
    //     explicit point/vector converters from `library Transforms`.

    //==
    // # Catmull-Rom splines
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline#Catmull-Rom_spline
    //
    // TODO(cross-package): only the UNIFORM (Alpha = 0) parameterization is
    // evaluated here, because `library Polynomials` provides the uniform basis.
    // Centripetal / chordal Catmull-Rom (Alpha = 0.5 / 1) needs knot spacings
    // proportional to the chord lengths raised to Alpha, i.e. a non-uniform
    // Hermite whose tangents are rescaled per span; that belongs next to the
    // basis in `polynomials.types.plato`, not here. Until it lands, `Alpha` is
    // documentation rather than behaviour.

    // The point on a Catmull-Rom spline at t, uniform parameterization.
    Eval(self: CatmullRomCurve2D, t: Number): Point2D
    {
        var n = self.Points.Count;
        var i = n.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t);
        var u = n.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t);
        return self.Points.AtWrapped(i - 1, self.Closed).PositionVector
            .CatmullRom(self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                        self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                        self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 2, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                        u)
            .ToPoint;
    }

    // The point on a Catmull-Rom spline at t, uniform parameterization.
    Eval(self: CatmullRomCurve3D, t: Number): Point3D
    {
        var n = self.Points.Count;
        var i = n.SpanIndex(self.Closed, t);
        var u = n.SpanFraction(self.Closed, t);
        return self.Points.AtWrapped(i - 1, self.Closed).PositionVector
            .CatmullRom(self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                        self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                        self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 2, self.Closed).PositionVector,
                        u)
            .ToPoint;
    }

    //==
    // # Kochanek-Bartels (TCB) splines
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kochanek%E2%80%93Bartels_spline
    // Tension flattens the curve at the knot, Bias skews the tangent toward the
    // incoming or outgoing chord, and Continuity breaks the tangent into
    // distinct arriving and departing halves. Each half is a weighted sum of
    // the two chords meeting at the knot; the four weights are pure Number
    // expressions shared by both dimensions.

    // The weight the departing tangent gives the incoming chord (p_i - p_i-1):
    // (1 - t)(1 + b)(1 + c) / 2.
    TcbOutgoingBackWeight(tension: Number, continuity: Number, bias: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - tension) * (1.0 + bias) * (1.0 + continuity) * 0.5;

    // The weight the departing tangent gives the outgoing chord (p_i+1 - p_i):
    // (1 - t)(1 - b)(1 - c) / 2.
    TcbOutgoingForwardWeight(tension: Number, continuity: Number, bias: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - tension) * (1.0 - bias) * (1.0 - continuity) * 0.5;

    // The weight the arriving tangent gives the incoming chord:
    // (1 - t)(1 + b)(1 - c) / 2.
    TcbIncomingBackWeight(tension: Number, continuity: Number, bias: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - tension) * (1.0 + bias) * (1.0 - continuity) * 0.5;

    // The weight the arriving tangent gives the outgoing chord:
    // (1 - t)(1 - b)(1 + c) / 2.
    TcbIncomingForwardWeight(tension: Number, continuity: Number, bias: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - tension) * (1.0 - bias) * (1.0 + continuity) * 0.5;

    // The chord arriving at knot i (p_i - p_i-1).
    TcbBackChord(self: TcbSpline2D, i: Integer): Vector2D
        => self.Points.AtWrapped(i - 1, self.Closed)
               .Between(self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed));

    // The chord leaving knot i (p_i+1 - p_i).
    TcbForwardChord(self: TcbSpline2D, i: Integer): Vector2D
        => self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
               .Between(self.Points.AtWrapped(i + 1, self.Closed));

    // The departing tangent at knot i.
    TcbOutgoingTangent(self: TcbSpline2D, i: Integer): Vector2D
        => self.TcbBackChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbOutgoingBackWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                          self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed))
         + self.TcbForwardChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbOutgoingForwardWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                             self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed));

    // The arriving tangent at knot i.
    TcbIncomingTangent(self: TcbSpline2D, i: Integer): Vector2D
        => self.TcbBackChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbIncomingBackWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                          self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed))
         + self.TcbForwardChord(i)
             * self.Tensions.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed)
                   .TcbIncomingForwardWeight(self.Continuities.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed),
                                             self.Biases.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed));

    // The chord arriving at knot i (p_i - p_i-1).
    TcbBackChord(self: TcbSpline3D, i: Integer): Vector3D
        => self.Points.AtWrapped(i - 1, self.Closed)
               .Between(self.Points.AtWrapped(i, self.Closed));
